# Convert Effect TypeScript to Effeck

You convert one Effect 4 TypeScript file into the equivalent Effeck file.

Answer with exactly one fenced `ts` code block holding the whole Effeck file, and nothing else.

- Keep every export, with its name.
- Drop imports from `"effect"`: Effeck has Effect's root modules and common functions in scope.
- Use the Effeck forms below wherever the input uses the Effect form they replace.
- Keep the program's behavior. Add nothing the input does not do, and do not explain.

## Syntax cheat sheet

Each row is one Effect form and the Effeck that replaces it.

| Effect 4 TypeScript | Effeck |
| --- | --- |
| `class NotFound extends Data.TaggedError("NotFound")<{ readonly id: string }> {}` | `error NotFound { id: string }` |
| `class Users extends Context.Service<Users, { find(id: string): Effect.Effect<User, NotFound> }>()("app/Users") {}` | `service Users { find(id: string): User!NotFound }` |
| `Effect.Effect<User, NotFound, Users>` | `User!NotFound!Users` (empty slot: never) |
| `yield* Effect.fail(new NotFound({ id }))` | `throw new NotFound({ id })` |
| `const user = yield* users.find(id)` | `const user = Users.find(id)` |
| `x.pipe(Effect.orElseSucceed(() => "guest"))` | `x catch "guest"` |
| `x.pipe(Effect.catchTag("NotFound", (e) => …))` | `x catch (e) => match (e) { when NotFound: …; }` |
| `x.pipe(Effect.retry(Schedule.recurs(3)), Effect.timeout("1 second"))` | `x \|> retry(%, Schedule.recurs(3)) \|> timeout(%, "1 second")` |
| `Effect.forEach(ids, f, { concurrency: 8 })` | `forEach(ids, f, { concurrency: 8 })` |
| `Effect.all([a, b], { concurrency: "unbounded" })` | `await.all [a(), b()]` |
| `Effect.provide(program, UsersLive)` | `provide UsersLive { … }` |

All of it in one program:

```ts
interface User { id: string; name: string }

error NotFound { id: string }

service Users {
  find(id: string): User!NotFound
}

const UsersLive = Layer.succeed(Users, {
  find(id) {
    if (id !== "1") throw new NotFound({ id })
    return { id, name: "Ada" }
  }
})

function nameOf(id: string) {
  return Users.find(id).name
    |> retry(%, Schedule.recurs(3))
    |> timeout(%, "1 second")
    catch "guest"
}

export function main() {
  provide UsersLive {
    const [a, b] = await.all [nameOf("1"), nameOf("2")]
    const all = forEach(["1", "2"], nameOf, { concurrency: 8 })
    log(`${a} ${b} ${all.length}`)
  }
}
```

## Examples

### 01-hero-batch-lookup

Input:

```ts
import { Context, Effect, Schedule, Schema } from "effect"

class ApiError extends Schema.TaggedError<ApiError>()("ApiError", {
  status: Schema.Number
}) {}

class Users extends Context.Service<Users, {
  name(id: string): Effect.Effect<string, ApiError>
}>()("app/Users") {}

const nameOf = Effect.fn("nameOf")(function* (id: string) {
  const users = yield* Users
  return yield* users.name(id).pipe(
    Effect.retry(Schedule.exponential("100 millis")),
    Effect.timeout("2 seconds"),
    Effect.orElseSucceed(() => "unknown")
  )
})

export const names = Effect.fn("names")(function* (ids: ReadonlyArray<string>) {
  const all = yield* Effect.forEach(ids, nameOf, { concurrency: 8 })
  yield* Effect.log(`Loaded ${all.length} names`)
  return all
})
```

Output:

```ts
error ApiError { status: number }

service Users {
  name(id: string): string!ApiError
}

function nameOf(id: string) {
  return Users.name(id)
    |> retry(%, Schedule.exponential("100 millis"))
    |> timeout(%, "2 seconds")
    catch "unknown"
}

export function names(ids: ReadonlyArray<string>) {
  const all = forEach(ids, nameOf, { concurrency: 8 })
  log(`Loaded ${all.length} names`)
  return all
}
```

### 02-typed-error-fallback

Input:

```ts
import { Data, Effect } from "effect"

class NotFound extends Data.TaggedError("NotFound")<{ readonly id: string }> {}

const find = (id: string): Effect.Effect<string, NotFound> =>
  id === "1" ? Effect.succeed("Ada") : Effect.fail(new NotFound({ id }))

export const greeting = (id: string) =>
  find(id).pipe(
    Effect.map((name) => `Hello, ${name}`),
    Effect.catchTag("NotFound", (e) => Effect.succeed(`No user ${e.id}`))
  )
```

Output:

```ts
error NotFound { id: string }

function find(id: string): string!NotFound {
  if (id !== "1") throw new NotFound({ id })
  return "Ada"
}

export function greeting(id: string) {
  return `Hello, ${find(id)}` catch (e) => match (e) {
    when NotFound: `No user ${e.id}`;
  }
}
```

### 03-service-and-layer

Input:

```ts
import { Context, Effect, Layer } from "effect"

class Clock2 extends Context.Service<Clock2, {
  readonly now: () => Effect.Effect<number>
}>()("app/Clock2") {}

const ClockLive = Layer.succeed(Clock2, { now: () => Effect.succeed(42) })

export const program = Effect.gen(function* () {
  const clock = yield* Clock2
  const t = yield* clock.now()
  return t * 2
}).pipe(Effect.provide(ClockLive))
```

Output:

```ts
service Clock2 {
  now(): number!!
}

const ClockLive = Layer.succeed(Clock2, {
  now() { return 42 }
})

export function program() {
  provide ClockLive {
    return Clock2.now() * 2
  }
}
```

### 04-layer-with-setup

Input:

```ts
import { Context, Effect, Layer } from "effect"

class Greeter extends Context.Service<Greeter, {
  greet(name: string): Effect.Effect<string>
}>()("app/Greeter") {}

export const GreeterLive = Layer.effect(Greeter, Effect.gen(function* () {
  const prefix = "Hello"
  yield* Effect.log("greeter ready")
  return Greeter.of({ greet: (name) => Effect.succeed(`${prefix}, ${name}`) })
}))
```

Output:

```ts
service Greeter {
  greet(name: string): string!!
}

export const GreeterLive = Layer.effect(Greeter) {
  const prefix = "Hello"
  log("greeter ready")
  return {
    greet(name) { return `${prefix}, ${name}` }
  }
}
```

### 05-retry-recurs

Input:

```ts
import { Data, Effect, Schedule } from "effect"

class Flaky extends Data.TaggedError("Flaky") {}

declare const fetchScore: Effect.Effect<number, Flaky>

export const score = fetchScore.pipe(Effect.retry(Schedule.recurs(3)))
```

Output:

```ts
error Flaky

declare function fetchScore(): number!Flaky

export function score() {
  return fetchScore() |> retry(%, Schedule.recurs(3))
}
```

### 06-timeout-fallback

Input:

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

const slow = Effect.sleep("5 seconds").pipe(Effect.as("done"))

export const quick = slow.pipe(
  Effect.timeout("1 second"),
  Effect.orElseSucceed(() => "too slow")
)
```

Output:

```ts
function slow() {
  sleep("5 seconds")
  return "done"
}

export function quick() {
  return slow() |> timeout(%, "1 second") catch "too slow"
}
```

Output:

### 08-all-concurrent

Input:

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

const user = Effect.succeed({ id: "1", name: "Ada" })
const orders = Effect.succeed([10, 20])

export const both = Effect.all([user, orders], { concurrency: "unbounded" }).pipe(
  Effect.map(([u, o]) => `${u.name} has ${o.length} orders`)
)
```

Output:

```ts
function user() {
  return { id: "1", name: "Ada" }
}

function orders() {
  return [10, 20]
}

export function both() {
  const [u, o] = await.all [user(), orders()]
  return `${u.name} has ${o.length} orders`
}
```

### 10-option-methods

Input:

```ts
import { Effect, Option } from "effect"

export const label = (value: Option.Option<number>) =>
  Effect.succeed(
    value.pipe(
      Option.map((n) => n + 1),
      Option.getOrElse(() => 0)
    )
  )
```

Output:

```ts

  return value.map((n) => n + 1).getOrElse(() => 0)
}
```

### 11-ref-counter

Input:

```ts
import { Effect, Ref } from "effect"

export const counted = Effect.gen(function* () {
  const ref = yield* Ref.make(0)
  yield* Ref.update(ref, (n) => n + 1)
  yield* Ref.update(ref, (n) => n + 1)
  return yield* Ref.get(ref)
})
```

Output:

```ts
export function counted() {
  const ref = Ref.make(0)
  Ref.update(ref, (n) => n + 1)
  Ref.update(ref, (n) => n + 1)
  return Ref.get(ref)
}
```

### 13-fork-join

Input:

```ts
import { Effect, Fiber } from "effect"

const work = (n: number) => Effect.sleep("10 millis").pipe(Effect.as(n))

export const both = Effect.gen(function* () {
  const a = yield* Effect.forkChild(work(1))
  const b = yield* Effect.forkChild(work(2))
  return [yield* Fiber.join(a), yield* Fiber.join(b)]
})
```

Output:

```ts
function work(n: number) {
  sleep("10 millis")
  return n
}

export function both() {
  const a = fork work(1)
  const b = fork work(2)
  return [join a, join b]
}
```

### 14-race

Input:

```ts
import { Effect } from "effect"

const cache = Effect.sleep("50 millis").pipe(Effect.as("cache"))
const network = Effect.sleep("10 millis").pipe(Effect.as("network"))

export const fastest = Effect.race(cache, network)
```

Output:

```ts
function cache() {
  sleep("50 millis")
  return "cache"
}

function network() {
  sleep("10 millis")
  return "network"
}

export function fastest() {
  return race(cache(), network())
}
```

### 17-stream-methods

Input:

```ts
import { Effect, Stream } from "effect"

export const hot = Stream.make(18, 25, 30).pipe(
  Stream.filter((c) => c >= 25),
  Stream.map((c) => `${c} C`),
```

### 18-catch-all

Input:

```ts
import { Data, Effect } from "effect"

class Timeout extends Data.TaggedError("Timeout") {}
class Refused extends Data.TaggedError("Refused")<{ readonly code: number }> {}

declare const call: Effect.Effect<string, Timeout | Refused>

export const safe = call.pipe(
  Effect.catch((e) => Effect.succeed(e._tag === "Timeout" ? "timed out" : `refused ${e.code}`))
)
```

Output:

```ts
error Timeout
error Refused { code: number }

declare function call(): string!Timeout | Refused

export function safe() {
  return call() catch (e) => match (e) {
    when Timeout: "timed out";
    when Refused: `refused ${e.code}`;
  }
}
```

### 19-sync-and-try

Input:

```ts
import { Data, Effect } from "effect"

class BadJson extends Data.TaggedError("BadJson")<{ readonly error: unknown }> {}

export const parsed = (text: string) =>
  Effect.try({ try: () => JSON.parse(text) as unknown, catch: (error) => new BadJson({ error }) })

export const id = Effect.sync(() => crypto.randomUUID())
```

Output:

```ts
error BadJson { error: unknown }

export function parsed(text: string) {
  return try((text) => JSON.parse(text) as unknown, (error) => new BadJson({ error }), text)
}

export function id() {
  return sync(crypto.randomUUID())
}
```
